items.title: Full-Wave Bridge Rectifier with Single Smoothing Capacitor (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Full-Wave Bridge Rectifier with Single Smoothing Capacitor: a main subheading of 17.14 Rectification, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 109-110.

blocks.text: AC se DC banate waqt rectification ke baad ripple voltage (output mein bacha hua upar neeche) kam karne ke liye smoothing filters lagate hain. Rectified output pulsating DC hota hai jo zyada tar electronic devices ke liye theek nahi. Smoothing filter AC components (ripples) ko filter kar ke zyada stable DC dete hain. Capacitor filter mein capacitor load ke parallel laga hota hai: rectified voltage barhe to capacitor charge hota hai, ghate to discharge ho kar load ko current deta hai; is tarah output smooth ho jata hai.

Smoothing (reservoir) capacitor output ke paar load ke parallel laga hota hai. Yeh storage device (energy jama karne wala aala) ki tarah kaam karta hai aur average DC output ko aur ooncha kar deta hai (Fig. 17.17). Yun rectifier ka full-wave ripple wala output kaafi smooth DC ban jata hai. Capacitor ki value badal kar output wave par is ka effect (asar) dekha ja sakta hai.

blocks.alt: Baen: full-wave bridge rectifier (D1 se D4, A aur B par AC source) aur +V aur 0 V ke darmiyan load R ke across smoothing capacitor C; green teer aik half cycle aur red teer doosre mein current dikhate. Daen: resultant wave; capacitor ke baghair dashed pulses, aur capacitor ke saath Vdc ke qareeb taqreeban seedhi lakeer jo C charge hone par uthti aur discharge hone par aahista girti hai, chhota ripple chhorti.
blocks.caption: Figure 17.17: Smoothing capacitor rectifier ke full-wave ripple wale output ko smooth DC voltage mein badalta hai (kitab ki Figure 17.17 ke mutabiq original drawing).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki Fig. 17.17 par 'Soothing capacitor' aur 'Wafeform' chhapa hai, aur dono teeron par 'with capacitor' likha hai. Sahi: smoothing capacitor aur waveform; oopar wali mazboot lakeer capacitor ke saath ki wave hai aur dashed pulses capacitor ke baghair ki.
Full-wave bridge rectifier mein sab se zyada ripple voltage frequency, load current aur smoothing capacitor teeno par depend (munhasir) karta hai:

blocks.title: Brain teaser
blocks.text: Hamara dil bijli ke pulses se dharakta hai. AC current ki frequency dil ki dharkan ki frequency ko bigar sakti hai aur heart attack (dil ka daura) ki wajah ban sakti hai; is liye AC ka jhatka khatarnak hai.

blocks.text_alt: V_ripple = I_DC/(f_ripple C)   or   V_ripple = I_DC/(2fC)

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab kehti hai ke ripple voltage smoothing capacitor ki value par depend nahi karta, sirf frequency aur load current par karta hai. Lekin usi ka formula V_ripple = I_DC/(2fC) batata hai ke C barhane se ripple kam hota hai. Sahi: ripple C, f aur load current teeno par depend karta hai.
Yahan I_DC load current (ampere), f input frequency aur C capacitance (farad) hai. Ripple frequency input frequency ki dugni hoti hai (har aadhe cycle mein ek pulse):

blocks.title: Izafi misal (kitab mein nahi)
blocks.problem: 50 Hz supply par full-wave bridge rectifier 2000 μF ke smoothing capacitor ke saath 0.5 A load current deta hai. Ripple voltage nikalein.

blocks.prompt: Full-wave rectifier ka output half-wave se zyada aasani se smooth kyun hota hai?
blocks.explanation: Full-wave mein pulses dugni dafa aate hain (ripple frequency 2f), is liye capacitor ko pulses ke darmiyan discharge hone ka aadha waqt milta hai, aur usi capacitor ke saath ripple taqreeban aadha reh jata hai.

items: Rectification: diode se AC ko DC banana (forward bias mein current guzarta hai).
Half-wave: ek diode, sirf ek aadha cycle; full-wave bridge: chaar diodes, dono aadhe cycles.
Load ke parallel smoothing capacitor; V_ripple = I_DC/(2fC), f_ripple = 2f.
